Live Bedrock two-call structured cache canary over identical prefix succeeds with typed completion_verdict; cache accounting matches documented contract: request count = 1 on each call, cache_write_tokens = 10685 on call 1, cache_read_tokens = 10685 on call 2, authenticated via ambient AWS chain.

Complete-vs-omit branch observed directly on both providers: wire projection instrumented on every before_model_request; COMPLETE branch exercised on all four calls (1 message in, 1 kept, 0 omitted); OMIT branch not exercised because no failed intermediate output response existed.

Observed accounting cross-checked against docs/llm-framework.md structured retry contract: exactly one outer run on well-formed first response matches (requests=1), output retry allowance resolution matches (2, zero consumed), cache read/write/input relationship matches (inclusive input convention verified identically on both providers), transport retry and native->prompted downgrade not exercised as expected for happy path.
